clips.title: The story
paras: The Stonefire Tavern is the primary inn serving travelers inside the mountain city of Ironforge. Situated in the bustling Commons district just north of the city gates, it provides a warm hearth, strong dwarven ale, and a resting place for adventurers arriving from across Khaz Modan.

Located immediately north of the fortress gates in the Commons, the Stonefire Tavern serves as the premier public house in Ironforge. Run by Innkeeper Firebrew alongside his daughter Gwenna, the inn offers weary wayfarers hearty meals, local brews, and lodging beneath the mountain. Whether seeking respite from the harsh mountain snows of Dun Morogh or looking to trade tales and supplies before venturing deep into the city, travelers from all corners of the Alliance routinely gather around its roaring hearth.
